verdicts.reason: A stacks the headline over the CTA, with the button at a readable size and the hierarchy intact. But the layout is very tight vertically: the headline sits almost against the top edge and the button nearly touches the bottom. B has a huge headline with almost no margin at the left and bottom. Its CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill with illegible label text, stranded at the far right edge and detached from the headline, so the CTA is buried.
